aria: Animated recap of the Rockets' 119 to 104 road win over the Pacers: Reed Sheppard's sixth 3-pointer with 7:51 left that made it 104 to 83, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Kevin Durant's 21 points, the top scorers, how the Rockets won, and the next game.

notes: Box score from the Rockets' 119–104 road win over the Indiana Pacers on Nov 18, 2026, from the Covers box score, with game details from the Associated Press (via CBS Sports and theScore), the Houston Chronicle (via Yahoo Sports), the game story carried by 95.3 The Score, Pacers On SI and Ball Exclusives (via Yardbarker). All 119 Houston points and all 104 Indiana points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (39–23–31–26 to 28–18–30–28) add up to both totals: 39–28 after one, 62–46 Houston at the half (AP; 95.3 The Score) and 93–76 after three (AP). Team totals (threes 19 of 35 to 10 of 34, rebounds 46–35, offensive rebounds 13–7, assists 30–25, points in the paint 40–56, fast-break points 7–20) are from the box score; the threes match Pacers On SI. Houston's biggest lead, 21, is from the box score and the Houston Chronicle; Indiana's, 4, is from the box score (Houston trailed for about the first two minutes, Chronicle). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Wednesday's games.

Houston won for the fifth time in six games (AP). The Rockets turned a 12–10 game into a 15–0 run for a 27–10 lead in the first quarter (AP; 95.3 The Score), and Indiana never got closer than nine after that (AP). Kevin Durant's dunk with 6:58 left in the half made it 49–30, and Amen Thompson's finger roll at the halftime buzzer made it 62–46 (95.3 The Score). Indiana's 12–0 third-quarter run cut it to 81–72 with 3:09 left in the quarter before Houston closed it on a 12–4 spurt (AP), finished by Marcus Smart's three with 31.5 seconds left for 93–76 (95.3 The Score). Reed Sheppard's 20 points were a season high (Houston Chronicle). Alperen Şengün was hit in the face with 7:21 left in the first half and did not return (AP); Pacers coach Rick Carlisle was ejected after two technical fouls (AP). Indiana played without Tyrese Haliburton and Andrew Nembhard (AP). Houston plays at Denver on Friday, Nov 20 at 10:00 PM ET, the last game of a four-game road trip (AP; Ball Exclusives).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Reed Sheppard's sixth 3-pointer of the night, with 7:51 left, that made it 104–83 (95.3 The Score), so the board shows Rockets +18 to +21. The written accounts don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc; the spot and the defender are not drawn to exact positions. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Houston Rockets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Reed Sheppard's listed 6-foot-2 and 185 pounds with No. 15 (RealGM; Wikipedia lists the same); no wingspan from a named measurement was found, so his arms use the default length. He is drawn in Houston's road colors with the default figure look (no approved look yet). It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
